scope: official-current-source verification for five registered GlobalSaaSHub tools after cross-checking existing individual application/result records

terms.official_conflict: current official signup portal states 40% one-time commission on the referral's first payment, while another current official Pictory partner page advertises recurring commissions up to 50%

results.safety_note: Do not submit an application until the active commercial terms are resolved from the actual application/terms flow; no duplicate application created.

terms.commission: 10%-20% per referral; official page also describes earnings of up to $20 per subscriber
terms.payout: commissions are verified and made available the following month; the exact commission duration is assigned in the affiliate partner group

terms.commission: 30% recurring for every referred customer for as long as the customer stays subscribed
terms.approval: application is reviewed before personalized affiliate dashboard/link access

results.dedupe_note: This revenue-share affiliate program is distinct from Social Champ's points/rewards Ambassador Program and older in-app referral flow; do not create duplicate enrollment across those paths.

terms.commission: 30% recurring for 0-5 paid accounts, scaling by tier up to 40% for 36+ paid accounts
terms.duration: for as long as the referral remains a paying Moosend customer

results.safety_note: The current application form contains a required marketing-communications consent checkbox. Do not auto-consent; stop for user approval if/when the application batch reaches that legal/marketing consent step.

terms.standard_tiers: 15% for 1 year at Standard, 20% for 1 year at Advanced, 25% for 1 year at Premium
terms.limited_lifetime_offer: 20% lifetime may be available if the affiliate brings at least one paid referral every three calendar months and contacts Reply.io to apply for that offer
terms.payout: PartnerStack supports PayPal, Stripe, and direct deposit
terms.referral_eligibility_note: official FAQ lists eligible signup regions as North America, Europe, and LATAM; this is recorded without assuming it is an affiliate-applicant residency restriction

correction_note: The first draft of this evidence file included ElevenLabs, Synthesia, HeyGen, and Descript. latest.json showed pre-existing individual application/result records for all four (including done/waiting_human states), so they were removed immediately instead of duplicating research. Existing individual results remain authoritative.
dedupe_rule: Existing individual application/result records override research-only classifications. Shared partner programs must not be applied to more than once. Already-completed UUIDs must not be recreated.
